verdict.rationale: Companies House runs a real authenticated REST API. Unauthenticated calls get a structured 'Empty Authorization header' challenge, consistent with free registered API keys, and the developer suite publishes a dedicated Authorisation guide, so the product does issue its own API credentials. Nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped or limited to least privilege, or issued per agent. missing for 10: documented credential scopes or permission levels, per-agent or per-key restriction controls, key rotation and revocation details, independent corroboration.
